reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in a thread on their #central-team message: "Thanks @tobias.rendle. Noted for everyone here: expense reports are due this Friday, 16 Oct."

The 16 Oct date is my own reading of "Friday", counted from the simulation date of Wednesday 14 Oct. GBrain had nothing on the expense deadline, but its search was running keyword-only, so that doesn't prove there's no note about it. I didn't set a calendar reminder because nobody asked for one.
